text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 430 x 270 mm, 1.5 mm aluminium; round the corners to 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure every hole from the left edge and the front edge; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole layout picture in the build plan gives every position.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six 4.5 mm holes for the standoffs, 11 mm from the front and back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Per channel (eight channels, 40 mm apart, first at 45 mm from the left):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 3.4 mm holder screw holes; a 16 x 5 mm wire slot behind the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holder and another between the charger and the channel board;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 3.4 mm holes for the board standoffs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6 mm holes for the guard rivet nuts; set M4 rivet nuts in them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 3.4 mm heatsink screw holes; 3.4 mm holes for the right-hand bay.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slots: drill 5 mm at each end, cut between, file; fit edge grommet strip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After wiring, each slot is filled with silicone round the leads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the holders and heatsink on it and look through each hole.
